name: get_important_emails
description: Fetch important inbox emails for a time window. Each message is scored 0-10 by an LLM; only messages with importance >= 5 are returned. Spam, bulk, and low-priority mail is excluded automatically. Results include subject, sender, date, summary, and action_items. Results are ephemeral — nothing is written to the repository. For raw query-driven search, use get_email_messages. For full thread reconstruction, use get_email_thread.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the start of the fetch window (e.g. "2026-03-03T06:00:00+00:00"). Defaults to 12 hours ago. Capped at 7 days ago.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: Optional ISO 8601 datetime for the end of the fetch window. Defaults to now if omitted.

inputs.name: unseen
inputs.description: If true, only fetch unread messages. Default false (fetch all in window).

outputs.description: Human-readable count of relevant emails returned.
Importance-filtered, LLM-summarized email list. Each item contains: subject, sender, email_address, date_received, summary, action_items, importance, thread_id, message_id.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments are:
start_date: ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. "2026-03-03T06:00:00+00:00"). Defaults to 12 hours ago.
end_date: Optional ISO 8601 datetime. Defaults to now.
unseen: true/false — restrict to unread mail (default false).

Behavior notes:
- Only inbox mail is considered; bulk/sent/spam folders are excluded.
- Each message is scored by an LLM (0-10 importance). Messages below 5 are not returned.
- Results are ephemeral — nothing is stored in the repository.
- The window is capped at 7 days maximum lookback.
- For raw query-driven search, use get_email_messages instead.
- For full thread context, use get_email_thread instead.

metadata.planner_description: Return recent inbox emails scored as important (spam/bulk filtered out).
